reinterpretation_verdict.keydemoted_is: demoted machine-jargon (raw process key, e.g. telLinear) — NOT an opaque actor-UUID; secondary/muted, never primary. Lesser-evil vs two indistinguishable «Процесс» rows; consistent with the already-blessed screen-process-instance.jsx convention.
reinterpretation_verdict.note: keyDemoted distinguishes DIFFERENT engine-only processes (different keys) on one record — the literal complaint. Two runs of the SAME key stay chip-identical (honest: distinguish instances via StepRef/StatusChip/link).

findings.issue: keyDemoted chip distinguishes DIFFERENT engine keys but NOT two instances of the SAME engine key (both telLinear render an identical chip). The founder complaint's plain reading is «несколько таких процессов … выглядели одинаково» (different processes) → resolved; but if the field case was 2 runs of one telLinear, the new chip does not add distinguishability there.
findings.suggestion: Non-blocking: instance-level distinguishing already works (StepRef/StatusChip/link → /processes/:id). Worth one line in the LIVE_PROOF that same-key instances rely on step/status, not the chip.

findings.issue: The true human-layer target (столп 4 / E-UX-HUMAN) is the real BPMN name «Канонический линейный ТЭЛ», not the raw slug telLinear. That remains only prose in the ADR (O-1), gated behind giving Flowable native tenantId — no backlog task exists, so it can be forgotten.
findings.suggestion: File O-1 as an actual backlog task (tenant-scoped live engine-name resolve, depends on native Flowable tenantId on deploy/start). keyDemoted is the correct P3-proportionate fix; O-1 is the follow-through.

findings.issue: LIVE_PROOF deferred (stand offline at coding time). Change is purely presentational and mechanically substituted (mutation-proof reproduced 1 RED; full web suite green), but per D-064 the human-slice should still be lived on the dev stand.
findings.suggestion: Non-blocking for the code verdict — run the 6-step live_proof_plan on the stand at/before promotion (secondary chip appears next to «Процесс» for 2+ engine-only rows).
